headline: Vermont soy wax candles for your aesthetic room refresh
body: Hand-poured in small batches with zero synthetic fragrances. Give your space that slow-morning glow while supporting independent Vermont makers.
rationale: This copy targets the Gen Z Aesthete by focusing on the visual room refresh and the tactile, small-batch vibe of the candle rather than dry functional details. It uses playful and aesthetic-forward framing while maintaining their values around independent craft.
